summary: Phase 3.3 — Native OurRealm Sounds Library Picker for Widget Builder. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASSED on /api/sounds/resolve (authed resolve preserves order, anonymous returns public-only, bogus IDs return empty {tracks:[]}, no ids returns empty, cap-50 enforced when 51 sent) and widget create with editor_config.fields=[{type:'sound'}] accepts both native sound IDs and legacy URLs as plain strings (3/3 variants). Frontend live-tested as @stealth on the preview shell: signin worked via data-testid='signin-email'/'signin-password'/'signin-submit'; navigated to /admin/widgets and edited existing 'Phase 3.3 Smoke' draft widget; Data tab shows 'Select from Sounds Library' button (data-testid='media-list-select-library-audio'); modal opens (data-testid='sounds-library-picker') and lists 3 sound-row-<id> cards for stealth's library (FORYOU_PROBE_UPLOAD, OurRealm Psy, sound-probe) with cover + Music category + play preview + Add button; multi-select counter updates the confirm to 'Use 2 sounds' (data-testid='sounds-picker-confirm'); on confirm the two field inputs show 'NATIVE ID' badges and the LIVE PREVIEW pane immediately renders custom-widget-sound-e477f465fd1e4b25b4bb909f8c5ae44f + custom-widget-sound-b77c6ea681314d24a5a452d23c125836 inline players with cover/title/category; mobile viewport (390x844) renders the picker full-width and scrollable with sticky Cancel/Use 2 Sounds footer.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/sounds.py:738 GET /resolve correctly uses lazy import + try/except wrapper for get_current_user so anonymous viewers don't get 401; preserves caller order via dict + list comprehension; caps at 50 BEFORE the Mongo lookup (slice raw_ids[:50]) — efficient and matches spec.
_can_view_track gate is reused as-is — public visible to all, private only to owner+founder, friends checks owner_friends set on viewer; clean reuse.
Founder bypass in _can_view_track means @stealth always resolves any track including private — INTENDED but worth documenting; not an issue.

SoundsLibraryPicker.jsx: all data-testids present (sounds-library-picker, sounds-library-list, sound-row-<id>, sound-preview-<id>, sound-select-<id>, sounds-library-empty, sounds-picker-confirm, sounds-picker-close, sounds-picker-audio). Multi/single mode toggle is clean.

CustomWidgetRenderer.jsx: data-testid='custom-widget-sound-<id>' for resolved, custom-widget-sound-missing-<id> for unavailable, custom-widget-sound-legacy for raw URLs — three-state coverage matches spec.
WidgetBuilder.jsx MediaListInput correctly gates the 'Select from Sounds Library' button on field.type==='sound' only (line 649). Video/image media fields will not render the button.

WidgetCreate Pydantic model uses extra='ignore', so the spec's request payload with top-level `data` is silently dropped — widget data lives at placement-instance level. Worth noting in the spec doc; not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (picker open, multi-select, NATIVE ID badges, live preview, mobile viewport — all verified live as @stealth)
